the only sourced fray depth we have is 12.7 mm — itsalwaysautumn.com frayed method: a straight stitch is sewn 1/2 in (12.7 mm) above the raw cut edge before washing, and after ONE wash/dry the page states the fray 'formed up to stitch line'. Caveat: the fray was ARRESTED by the stitching, so 12.7 mm is what one wash reached against a stop, not a free fray depth; and it is one garment, one fabric, one machine.
